_about: NC-1 channel 3 (Sam's Open Asks Sheet 113): an exhibit counts toward a noncredit institution's nc_exh when the credential it credits is one a CDCP course at that institution names. The builder (funding/_build_funding_performance.py, nc_outcome_counts) counts a row only when its status is 'confirmed' and at least one of its courses is still a CDCP course there (title_norm in the RPC's titles). 'proposed' rows count nothing. Rows were proposed by a keyword scan of exhibit titles against CDCP course titles at the same college (S473, 2026-10-25), each read by eye; rejected pairs are listed under 'rejected' so a later scan does not propose them again.
